data.gender_notes: Ehsun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-n', meaning 'to be good, beautiful, gracious'. In Islamic tradition, Ehsun signifies a gift or blessing from Allah. The name Ehsun carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ehsun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ehsun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.context: Ibn Kathir mentions a man named Ehsun al-Ansari who participated in the Battle of Hunayn (10/15) in the time of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was a close companion and the standard-bearer of the Prophet. His bravery during the battle was exemplary.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz Al-Sahabah by Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani The name Ehsun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Hajar writes about Ehsun al-Ansari being one of the Sahabah (Companions of the Prophet Muhammad). He was among those who were present at the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and the Battle of Mu'tah. Ehsun was also the standard-bearer for the Prophet during the Battle of Hunayn.
